title: Membership in the size language
statement: For a family of Boolean circuits, a natural number $i$ satisfies $i<\mathrm{size}(C_n)$ if and only if the string encoding $n$ copies of the bit $1$ followed by the binary representation of $i$ belongs to the family’s size language.
